answer_1.quote: We introduce a new dataset of human annotated video caption (1 sentence) and summaries (3-10 sentences) to gauge the ability of VLMs to perform long form summary of video content.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates both short video captions (1 sentence) and long video summaries (3-10 sentences) as NLG outputs.

answer_2.quote: For N-gram-based metrics, following prior works such as MSR-VTT, we report commonly used metrics including BLEU, ROUGE-L and CIDEr to gauge the quality of the model-generated captions.

answer_4.quote: we randomly selected 20 videos and manually ranked summaries from annotators 1 and 5 by their perceived quality and relatedness to the video content.
answer_4.guideline: manual ranking of summaries based on perceived quality and relatedness to the video content
